title: Cerebus #130 : Jaka's Story : January 1990 - ISSN 0712-7774
descriptionText:
Cerebus #130, "Jaka's Story," is a compelling issue from January 1990, marking a significant part of the 23-issue narrative within the Estarcion universe. Published by Aardvark-Vanaheim, this comic book is a testament to the creative genius of Dave Sim, who not only serves as the artist/writer but also showcases his talent in the cover art. 

As part of the Copper Age of comics, this single issue is a collectible that resonates with enthusiasts of classic US comics. It is presented in a black and white style, highlighting the raw, visceral storytelling that Sim is renowned for. "Jaka's Story" comes in English language, is a first printing, and is a must-have for followers of the Cerebus series and aficionados of strong, character-driven narratives.
